mercimek.name: Ọsịsọ Lentil
mercimek.description: Ọsịsọ lentil nke e si n'ụlọ, kwadebere n'ụdị omenala, zuru oke na mmanya mmiri ara ehi.

tas-kebabi.name: Stew Ebeef nke Turkey
tas-kebabi.description: Ebeef, akwụkwọ nri nke oge, na mmanụ pụrụ iche nke ụlọ oriri anyị na-esi nwayọ nwayọ.

kuzu-tandir.name: Atụrụ a kụrụ nwayọ nwayọ
kuzu-tandir.description: Atụrụ tandoori nke ụlọ oriri anyị na-esi nwayọ nwayọ na ọkụ dị ala.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Osikapa Pilaf
pirinc-pilavi.description: Osikapa pilaf Baldo nke e sere na mmanya ara ehi, dị nro.

firin-sutlac.name: Puding Osikapa E jiri oka mma esi ya
firin-sutlac.description: Puding osikapa e sere n'ụzọ omenala, kwadebere na mmiri ara ehi búffulo kwa ụbọchị.

kuru-fasulye.name: Stew Akpụkpọ Ocha na Efu
kuru-fasulye.description: Akpụkpọ İspir, efu tụrụ n'ime obere ibe, na pasta tomati dị mfe nke ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.

izgara-kofte.name: Ụgbọ Efu Grilled
izgara-kofte.description: Ụgbọ efu ụdị onye na-ere anụ na ose roasted na tomati.

ayran.name: Ayran Churned
ayran.description: Ayran churned ọdịnala nwere nnukwu mmanụ, si na yogọt kwa ụbọchị.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Ọsikapa Ezogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Ọsikapa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ ọdịnala ebe lentil uhie, bulgur, na osikapa zukọtara na mint.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Ọsikapa Tarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana nke a na-eme n’ụlọ, otu klasik Anatolia nke na-esi nwayọ na tomati na mint akọrọ.

yayla-corbasi.name: Nnyocha Yogọt na Osikapa
yayla-corbasi.description: Ose pụrụ iche na nke creamy nke yayla, e kwadebere ya na yogurt, osikapa, na mint akọrọ.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Ose Ahụ Ehi
iskembe-corbasi.description: Ọse anụ ehi nke ọma e ji ya na ose ya na vinega garlic.

dugun-corbasi.name: Ose Alụmdi na Nwunye
dugun-corbasi.description: Ọse alụmdi na nwunye ọdịnala e kwadebere ya na ehi ewepụkpụ ma jiri lemon tinye ụtọ.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Ọse Nkụ azụ ọkụkọ
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Ọse mgbake e kwadebere ya na noodle dị ọkụ na anụ ọkụkọ ewepụkpụ.

domates-corbasi.name: Ose Tomato
domates-corbasi.description: Nri ụtọ bara ụba esi na tomati a ghere ọkụ, mmanụ aṅụ, na basil, kpochapụwo ya na chiz.

sebze-corbasi.name: Ụtaba akwụkwọ nri
sebze-corbasi.description: Ụtaba ọkara ụlọ oriri esiri na akwụkwọ nri oge, mmanụ oliv, na ahịhịa ọhụrụ.

beyran-corbasi.name: Ụtaba Ewu Beyran na-atọ ụtọ
beyran-corbasi.description: Ụtaba mpaghara esiri na ọkụ dị elu na ewu, osikapa, yabasị, na ose ọjọọ.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Ụtaba Isi na Ụkwụ
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Ụtaba mmiri ọkpụkpụ bara ụba nke esiri na ụkwụ anụ ezi na anụ isi esi ọtụtụ awa.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Ụtaba Vermicelli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Ụtụtụ mmiri ofe esi na mmanụ anụ ọhịa ọkụkọ, tomates, vermicelli, na parsley.

tavuk-sis.name: Ụzọkọ Ọkụkọ
tavuk-sis.description: Mpempe anụ ọkụkọ e jiri ngwa nri pụrụ iche mee ka esi ya, na-eje ozi na ose na tomates esere.

kasap-sucuk.name: Sucuk Onye Ahịa Esi Na Grill
kasap-sucuk.description: Sosis anụ ezi dị ụtọ esi na charbon, na akwụkwọ nri esere na yabasị nwere sumac.

karisik-izgara.name: Grill Ntụgharị
karisik-izgara.description: Efere grill jupụtara na nke dị iche iche nke nwere meatballs, ụzọkọ anụ ọkụkọ, chops atụrụ, na sosis.

nohut-yemegi.name: Ofe Chickpea na Anụ Ezi
nohut-yemegi.description: Nri esi n'ụlọ nke chickpeas na anụ ezi e bee obere nke a na esi nwayọ n'ime ite ígwè.

patlican-musakka.name: Moussaka Eggplant
patlican-musakka.description: Eggplant a gbara ọkụ, anụ ezi e juru eze, na moussaka a tiere n’ọfịs na ose tomatọ, n'ụdị ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ n’Mmanụ Oliv
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Ọ bụ ụdị nri esi na mmanụ olivụ na beans akwụkwọ ndụ, tomatọ, na yabasị, a na-ejikwa jụọ oyi.

tavuk-sote.name: Ntụrụ anụ ọkụkọ
tavuk-sote.description: A na-etinye akụkụ anụ ọkụkọ n'elu ọkụ dị elu na ose agba, mushrooms, na tomatọ.

izmir-kofte.name: Ube Anụ N'ụzọ İzmir
izmir-kofte.description: Efere isi nri ọdịnala nke bọọlụ ehi, mkpụrụ ịgba, na ose e siere na mmanụ tomato.

etli-bezelye.name: Awụ mmiri na Ehi
etli-bezelye.description: Nri ụbọchị kwa ụbọchị esi na ite na ehi akpụkụ, awụ mmiri, karọt, na mkpụrụ ịgba.

patlican-oturtma.name: Akwụkwọ aubergine esi na Ntụrụ Mince
patlican-oturtma.description: Asịrị ehi esi na oven na aubergine, anụ minsi na-atọ ụtọ, na mmanụ tomato garlic.

salgam-suyu.name: Mmanya Turnip Fermented
salgam-suyu.description: Mmanya turnip ọdịnala na-atọ ụtọ, nke fermented na karọt aja aja na yisị bulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Mmiri Mineral
maden-suyu.description: Mmiri mineral eke dị ọcha e ji sụọ oyi.

su.name: Mmiri Mmiri Ọhụụ
su.description: Mmiri mmiri sitere n'ọhụụ na-eju oyi n'ime karama iko.

kola.name: Kola
kola.description: Mmanya carbonated nke ndị mmadụ maara nke ọma na-eju oyi.

gazoz.name: Soda Lemon Turkish
gazoz.description: Soda ọdịnala nwere ụtọ, na-eme ka ahụ dị ọhụrụ, na-eju oyi.

turk-kahvesi.name: Kọfị Turkish
turk-kahvesi.description: Kọfị ọdịnala Turkish nwere iwe, esiri na okpomọkụ dị elu n'ime cezve ọla kọpa.

demleme-cay.name: Ti Turkish Brewed
demleme-cay.description: Ti Rize ọhụrụ e biri ebi na-ekpo ọkụ n'ime iko nwere mgbakwunye dịtụ.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Lemonade N'ụlọ
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Mmanya lemon nke na-enye ume ọhụrụ a na-eme kwa ụbọchị site na lemon ọhụrụ, mint, na obere shuga.

hosaf.name: Compote mkpụrụ osisi kwa ụbọchị
hosaf.description: Compote ndị e mere n'ụlọ a na-esi kwa ụbọchị site na raisins, apricot, ma ọ bụ plum dabere na oge.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Anụ a na-eji ụdọ na-atụgharị n'elu pide, a na-eje ya na ose tomatọ, mmanụ ọkụ na-esi ísì ụtọ, na ihe ọṅụṅụ mmiri ara ehi.

kazandibi.name: Pudding Mmiri Ara Ehi Caramel
kazandibi.description: Ịhe mmanya mmiri ara ehi nke ọdịnala dị mma caramelized nke ọma, nwere akpụkpọ anụ dị nro.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Pudding Mmiri Ara Ehi Ottoman
tavuk-gogsu.description: Ube mmiri ara ehi dị mfe ma dịkwa nro, a na-eme ya site na nkuzi omenala, e jiri ọrịa okwụrụ ya.

keskul.name: Pudding Mmiri Ara Ehi Almond
keskul.description: Nri mmiri ara ehi ụdị Ottoman, e mechara ya site n'ịgbakwunye ụtọ almond na nkịtị.

irmik-helvasi.name: Halva Semolina
irmik-helvasi.description: Halva semolina, e jidere ya na mmanụ aṅụ na mkpụrụ pine, a na-enye ya ọkụ na ntụ ọka.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Nri Akwụkwọ Nkọkọ na Tahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Akwụkwọ ahụ na-esi na mmiri nke ya dị ọkụ nwayọ, a na-enye ya na tahini na mkpụrụ oliv.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Nri Quince
ayva-tatlisi.description: Quince a na-esi na cloves na cinnamon, a na-enye ya na mmanụ anụ ehi sie ọkụ na mkpụrụ oliv.

revani.name: Achịcha Nsị Semolina
revani.description: Nri ụtọ ụlọ oriri ochie ebe achịcha semolina dị nro na-ezukọta na sirop nke na-afụ ụtọ lemon.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Pudịn Bread na Clotted Cream
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Pudịn bread e zuo ike na sirop caramelized na ewetara ya na clotted cream ewu bufalo.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava Walnut
cevizli-baklava.description: Cácpụ dị warara nke ọma, baklava dị mkpụmkpụ nke eji ọtụtụ walnut na mmanụ aṅụ dị ọcha mee.
